# Lapstyle

> Desktop Vue UI kit. Use Ls* / ls-* components (v-model, events, slots). CSS tokens are the look layer.

Install: `pnpm add github:lapintool/lapstyle#v0.5.0-alpha`
Setup: `app.use(LapstyleVue)` and `import "lapstyle/index.css"`.
Theme: `<html data-theme="dark|light|mint|sky|pink|brown|amber">`.

Read these files in the installed package (paths relative to the package root):

- Getting started: docs/getting-started.md
- Theming: docs/theming.md
- Full pack: docs/llms-full.txt
- Types: src/vue/index.d.ts
- LsBtn (ls-btn): docs/components/ls-btn.md
- LsGroup (ls-group): docs/components/ls-group.md
- LsBtnDropdown (ls-btn-dropdown): docs/components/ls-btn-dropdown.md
- LsInput (ls-input): docs/components/ls-input.md
- LsField (ls-field): docs/components/ls-field.md
- LsRadio (ls-radio): docs/components/ls-radio.md
- LsCheckbox (ls-checkbox): docs/components/ls-checkbox.md
- LsTabs (ls-tabs): docs/components/ls-tabs.md
- LsTab (ls-tab): docs/components/ls-tab.md
- LsDropdown (ls-dropdown): docs/components/ls-dropdown.md
- LsDialog (ls-dialog): docs/components/ls-dialog.md
- LsTooltip (ls-tooltip): docs/components/ls-tooltip.md
- LsIcon (ls-icon): docs/components/ls-icon.md
- LsMenu (ls-menu): docs/components/ls-menu.md
- LsCard (ls-card): docs/components/ls-card.md
- LsTable (ls-table): docs/components/ls-table.md
- LsSlider (ls-slider): docs/components/ls-slider.md
- LsProgress (ls-progress): docs/components/ls-progress.md
- LsExpand (ls-expand): docs/components/ls-expand.md
- LsSplitter (ls-splitter): docs/components/ls-splitter.md
- LsColorPicker (ls-color-picker): docs/components/ls-color-picker.md
- Scrollbar (CSS only): docs/components/scrollbar.md
- Framework-free: docs/enhance.md

Rules for coding agents:
- Prefer `<ls-*>` from `lapstyle/vue`. Do not copy class HTML from demos.
- `enhance()` is for pages without Vue. See `docs/enhance.md`.
- Default button color follows `--ls-accent`; do not hardcode gray unless asked.
- If a component page is not enough, read `src/vue/<Name>.vue` next, then `src/js/`.
